metadata.name: AND gate
metadata.notes:
The simplest circuit: two switches feed an AND gate, and its output lights an LED.

Click a switch to turn it on. The LED lights only while both switches are on. A wire glows while it carries a 1, so you can follow each switch's signal to the LED.

Try: select the AND gate, press Delete, and place an OR gate (press O, then click) where it was. Wire it the same way: now either switch lights the LED.
